architecture: Selected release weights frozen; adaptation confined to declared control heads/rankers

budget.objective: fixed observation count; no travel optimality claim
budget.travel_cost: record Euclidean receiver displacement and supplied nonnegative costs; no shortest path claim
budget.no_valid_action: return single-observation result with zero query cost; include in all-sample metrics

deployment_inputs: source-independent validity in new generated benchmark
historical_scope: Historical receiver sampling is source-conditioned through distance strata and target-visible-point filtering. These data support conditional-menu controlled experiments, not source-independent deployment claims.

splits.test: previously exposed supplemental evaluation; never model selection
splits.fresh_confirmation: requires separately generated common-menu evidence; no pristine unseen-scene claim

weights: equal starting-observation weight; paired scene-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals; report scene macro mean
planning: between-group predictive disagreement heuristic, not exact expected information gain

grouping.method: deterministic complete-link mask IoU, exact-duplicate normalization
grouping.meaning: geometric hypothesis families; not proven physical instances

standard_control: same candidate support, two audio semantic representations, full complex covariances, pose, spatial direct residuals and same TRAIN supervision

interpretation.new_surface: second-only measured voxels; no verified occlusion completion
interpretation.pose: provided rigid receiver poses; no estimated registration
interpretation.uncertainty: log_variance error association and calibration diagnostics; no calibrated uncertainty claim
interpretation.ranker: bounded correction can degrade; no safety guarantee
